title: 第322章 师兄哪吒18拿什么将她占为己有第321章 师兄哪吒17既然是姐姐吩咐我照做便是
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 哪吒盯着她看了两秒，唇角微微上扬，没再说什么，自然地躺到了床的外侧。
江盼僵硬地躺在内侧，和他之间隔了半臂的距离。
以前灵珠子睡在她身边时，小小一团，蜷在她怀里，她只觉得软乎乎的很可爱。
可现在身边躺着的是一个比她高出一个头的少年，宽肩窄腰长手长脚，呼吸声都清晰可闻——
她整个人都不好了。
“姐姐。”
“你离我好远。”
江盼心跳漏了一拍：“哪里远了？就在一张床上。”
哪吒翻过身来，面朝着她。
月光从窗棂缝隙里漏进来，落在他的脸上，将他清俊的轮廓映得格外分明。
他伸出手臂，一把将她捞了过来。
动作行云流水，一气呵成。
江盼还没反应过来，整个人已经被圈进了他怀里。
少年的胸膛温热结实，心跳声就在她耳边，“咚咚咚咚”
，一下接着一下，撞得人心尖发颤。
“哪吒！
她使劲推他，推不动。
“你放开我！”
“不放。”
他把下巴轻抵在她发顶，嗓音裹着浅浅困意，闷闷软软，“从前我们都是这么睡的。”
“以前你才多大！
现在你——”
“现在我也还是我。”
他打断她，语气理所当然，“姐姐，别闹了，睡觉。”
到底是谁在闹啊！
她想挣扎，可他的手臂像铁箍一样箍在她腰间，根本挣不开。
而且……他的体温透过薄薄的中衣传过来，暖洋洋的，像一个大号人形暖炉。
秋夜很凉，这个温度刚刚好。
江盼在心里唾弃了自己三秒钟，然后……没再挣扎。
奶龙：【宿主，你的骨气呢？】
江盼：被暖气蒸发了。
算了，不拆穿她了。
窗外的月光一寸一寸地移，房间里只剩下两道交缠的呼吸声。
江盼以为哪吒已经睡着了，小心翼翼抬起头，想看一眼他的脸——
正对上那双漆黑的眸子。
他根本没睡。
他就那样垂着眼看她，目光沉沉的，像一潭看不见底的水。
月光落在他的眼睛里，碎成细密的光点。
content_en:
Nezha stared at her for two seconds, raised the corners of his lips slightly, and lay down on the outside of the bed without saying anything else.
Jiang Pan lay stiffly on the inside, half an arm's length away from him.
When Lingzhuzi slept next to her before, he was a small ball curled up in her arms. She only felt that it was soft and cute.
But now lying next to her was a young man who was a head taller than her. He had broad shoulders, narrow waist, long hands and long legs, and his breathing could be heard clearly——
Her whole body was not well.
"Sister."
"...for what?"
"You are so far away from me."
Jiang Pan's heart skipped a beat: "How far away? It's just on the same bed."
Nezha turned over and faced her.
The moonlight filtered in through the gaps in the window lattice and fell on his face, making his handsome outline particularly clear.
He stretched out his arm and picked her up.
The movements are smooth and smooth, done in one go.
Before Jiang Pan could react, he was already trapped in his arms.
The boy's chest was warm and strong, and the heartbeat was in her ears, "dong dong dong dong"
, one after another, making people tremble.
"Nezha!
! "
She pushed him hard but couldn't push him.
"Let me go!"
"Don't let go."
He put his chin lightly on the top of her hair, and his voice was soft and muffled with a hint of sleepiness, "We used to sleep like this."
"How old were you before!
Now you-"
"I'm still me now."
He interrupted her and said in a matter-of-fact tone, "Sister, stop making trouble and go to sleep."
Jiang Pan: "..."
Who is making the fuss?
She wanted to struggle, but his arms were like iron hoops around her waist, and she couldn't break free at all.
And...his body temperature spread through the thin middle coat, making him feel warm, like a large human-shaped heater.
The autumn night is very cool and the temperature is just right.
Jiang Pan despised himself in his heart for three seconds, and then... stopped struggling.
Milk Dragon: [Host, where is your backbone? 】
Jiang Pan: Evaporated by the heating.
Milk Dragon: [……]
Forget it, let’s not expose her anymore.
The moonlight outside the window moved inch by inch, and there were only two intertwined breathing sounds left in the room.
Jiang Pan thought Nezha had fallen asleep, so he raised his head cautiously, trying to take a look at his face——
Face to face with those dark eyes.
He didn't sleep at all.
He just looked at her with his eyes downcast, like a pool of water with no bottom.
The moonlight fell in his eyes and broke into fine spots of light.
title_en: Chapter 322 Senior Brother Nezha 18 Why did he take her as his own? Chapter 321 Senior Brother Nezha 17 Since it is my sister who told me to do it, I will do it.
